div.head: Af 18.1
div.ab: Gif beweddod fæmne hy forlicge, gif heo sy cierlisc, mid LX scll' gebete ðam þe hit gebyrie, ⁊ ðæt sy on cwicæhtum feogodum, ⁊ mon nænigne mon on ðæt ne sylle.
Gif beweddodu fæmne hie forlicgge, gif hio sie cirlisc, mid LX scill. gebete þam byrgean, ⁊ þæt sie on cwicæhtum feogodum, ⁊ mon nænigne mon on ðæt ne selle.
Si desponsata femina fornicetur et cirlisca sit, LX solid. emendetur marito, et hoc in uiuente captali componatur, et nemo uendatur in (pro) eo.
Gif beweddodu fæmne hie forlicgge, gif hio sie cirlisc, mid LX scill gebete þam byrgean, ⁊ þæt sie on cwicæhtum feogodum, ⁊ mon nænigne mon on ðæt ne selle.

If a contractually betrothed woman fornicates [with someone other than her intended husband], if she is of ceorl rank, let her compensate the guarantor [to the marriage] with 60 shillings, and that must be in livestock, and no person [in servitude] can be given for that.

If a young woman who is betrothed commits fornication, she shall pay compensation to the amount of 60 shillings to the surety [of the marriage], if she is a commoner. The sum shall be [paid] in livestock, cattle being the property tendered, and no leave shall be given in such payment.

If a betrothed maiden commits fornication, if she is of ceorl birth, 60 shillings compensation is to be paid to the surety; and it is to be paid in livestock, cattle 1 [only], and one is not to include in it any slave.

Wenn eine verlobte Jungfrau sich beschlafen lässt, so büsse sie, wenn sie gemeinfrei ist, dem [Verlobungs]bürgen mit 60 Schilling, und dies [Bussgeld] bestehe in Lebgütern, Werthgegenständen; und man veräussere dabei keinen [unfreien] Menschen.

If a betrothed girl lets herself be lain with, then, if she is of common-free rank, let her pay the [betrothal-]surety 60 shillings, and let this [compensation] consist of livestock, goods of value; and let no [unfree] person be given away in it.
